<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Shin Bet]] and the [[Israeli Defence Forces]] announce the arrests of eleven suspected members of the [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] [[Islamic Jihad Organization|Islamic Jihad]] terror group off the [[Gaza Strip|Gazan]] coast suspected of planning an attack on the [[Israeli Navy]]. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/244021 (Israel National News)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/shin-bet-idf-thwart-islamic-jihad-attack-on-navy-boats-off-gaza-coast/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**Protests enter a second week, with the death toll from last week's clashes at the [[Israel]]i-[[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]n border rising to 19. [[Hamas]] organisers direct participants to stay well back from the border fence to prevent further violence. [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/palestinians/.premium-tens-of-thousands-of-palestinians-prepare-for-second-weekend-protest-1.5975456 (''Haaretz'')]
**The [[Palestinian Authority]] asks the [[United Nations]] to investigate. [http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/gaza-news/Palestinians-tell-UN-Israel-adopted-shoot-to-kill-policy-in-Gaza-547850 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**Israeli [[human rights]] group [[B'Tselem]] launches a campaign calling on soldiers to refuse orders at the border. [https://972mag.com/btselem-to-israeli-soldiers-refuse-orders-to-shoot-gaza-protesters/134398/ (''+972'')]
**[[Ahmed Aboul Gheit]], head of the [[Arab League]], asks the [[International Criminal Court]] for an investigation. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/arab-league-wants-icc-to-probe-idf-shootings-of-gaza-protesters/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**The [[Israeli Defence Forces]] state one of their jets opened fire on a man near the [[Gaza Strip|Gazan]] border yesterday, saying the individual was an armed terrorist. [https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5220851,00.html (Ynet)]
*[[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**[[West Yorkshire Police|Police]] questioning two men suspected of plotting terror attacks in [[Dewsbury]], [[West Yorkshire]], are granted an extension until April 10 to detain the suspects. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-leeds-43638551 (BBC)]
*[[Terrorism in Syria]]
**The parents of Ayşe Deniz Karacagil, killed in [[Raqqa]], [[Syria]], after she joined the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]], are acquitted of a terrorism propaganda charge for attending her funeral. [http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/parents-of-girl-who-died-fighting-in-pkk-ranks-acquitted-of-terror-charges-129793 (''Hurriyet Daily News'')]
*[[Terrorism in Egypt]]
**The [[Sohag]] Criminal Court in [[Egypt]] sentences 35 alleged [[Muslim Brotherhood]] members to life imprisonment and imposes prison terms on 155 more. Separately, a military court sentences four more to life imprisonment, imposes prison terms on two others, and acquits 13. [http://www.startribune.com/egypt-sentences-35-to-life-on-terror-charges/478738093/ (''The Star Tribune'')]
*[[Terrorism in Turkey]]
**Police across the nation arrest a total of 29 alleged coup participants on suspicion of terrorism. [https://aa.com.tr/en/turkey/turkey-police-arrest-29-feto-linked-terror-suspects/1107905 (Anadolu Agency)]
*Authorities in [[Ukraine]] announce the arrest of a suspected terrorist in connection with a 2017 [[Kiev]] attack that killed two and wounded three including MP [[Ihor Mosiychuk]]. [http://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/496664.html (Interfax)]
*[[List of people indicted in the International Criminal Court]]
**[[Mali]]an alleged [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremist]] war criminal Al Hassan Ag Abdoul Aziz Ag Mohamed Ag Mahmoud makes an initial appearance before the [[International Criminal Court]] accused of demolishing shrines in [[Timbuktu]], [[war rape|rape]], torture, and sexual enslavement. [http://www.enca.com/world/timbuktu-malian-jihadist-faces-war-crimes-court (ENCA)]
*[[Djibouti]] grounds all flights at a US military base in the country after two accidents in two days. The base is used for counterterror operations in [[Yemen]] and [[Somalia]]. [http://www.euronews.com/2018/04/05/flights-grounded-u-s-military-base-africa-crucial-anti-terror-n862961 (Euronews)]

;Business and economy
*[[High-speed rail in Europe]]
**The first ever direct train from [[London]] to [[Amsterdam]] departs from [[St Pancras railway station]]. The new [[Eurostar]] service estimated at three hours and 41 minutes arrived six minutes behind schedule. [https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/eurostar-london-amsterdam-direct-train-live-latest-updates-st-pancras-service-launch-netherlands-a8287041.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Jet Airways]] of [[India]] orders 75 [[Boeing]] [[B737|737 Max]] jets. [https://www.flightglobal.com/news/articles/jet-airways-finalises-follow-on-order-for-75-737-max-447280/ (Flight Global)]
*[[Bahrain]] says a recently-discovered offshore oilfield in its territorial waters contains 80 billion barrels of [[petroleum]]. [https://oilprice.com/Energy/Crude-Oil/Bahrain-Says-Giant-Discovery-Holds-80-Billion-Barrels-Of-Oil.html (OilPrice.com)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A fire at the Perseus shopping centre in western [[Moscow]] kills at least one person and injures at least six others. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/moscow-shopping-centre-fire-latest-updates-russia-persei-mall-evacuations-casualties-a8287926.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2018 Balikpapan oil spill]]
**The port city of [[Balikpapan]], [[Borneo]], [[Indonesia]] declares a state of emergency in response to an ongoing oil spill fire off the coast. The spill and fire killed four fishermen and is releasing toxic fumes. The slick currently extends to around seven square miles and marine fauna including protected species are being affected. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/04/emergency-declared-after-oil-spill-ignites-on-indonesian-island-of-borneo (''The Guardian'')]
*A fire in a building housing the [[Portugal|Portuguese]], [[Tunisia]]n, [[Argentina|Argentinian]] and [[Belgium|Belgian]] embassies in [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]] injures 14 people. A man is arrested on suspicion of arson. [https://www.thelocal.se/20180404/police-suspect-arson-after-fire-at-stockholm-embassy-building-injures-14 (''The Local'')]
*A [[United States|U.S.]] [[US Air Force|Air Force]] [[F-16]] crashes at the [[Nevada Test and Training Range]] near [[Las Vegas]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/04/04/us-f-16-crashes-near-las-vegas-third-crash-two-days/ (''The Telegraph'')]

;Health and environment
*[[President of the Philippines|Philippine President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] announces the six-month closure of the island of [[Boracay]] in [[the Philippines]], starting April 26. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/199580-duterte-orders-closure-boracay-6-months (Rappler)]

;International relations
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The leaders of [[Iran]], [[Turkey]] and [[Russia]] meet in [[Ankara]]. They declare their commitment to achieving a "lasting ceasefire" in [[Syria]]. [https://ahvalnews.com/ankara-summit/turkey-iran-and-russia-committed-lasting-ceasefire-ankara-summit (Ahval)]
*[[Illegal immigration to the United States]] 
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] signs an order sending the [[National Guard of the United States|National Guard]] to patrol the [[Mexico–United States border]] in response to Congress's failure to pass tightened border security measures. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/live-white-house-briefing-april-4-2018-live-stream/ (CBS)]
**The [[Viacrucis del Migrante]] caravan of mostly Central American migrants is stopped by Mexican authorities. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-caravan/mexico-vets-and-disperses-central-american-migrant-caravan-idUSKCN1HA2D0 (Reuters)]
*[[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]]
**Lawyers representing [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] are told by [[FBI]] special counsel [[Robert Mueller]] the President is considered to be more than a witness but is not under criminal investigation. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/04/politics/donald-trump-robert-mueller/index.html (CNN)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[United States]] [[US Senate|Senator]] [[Dick Durbin]] visits [[Venezuela]] to negotiate the release of Joshua Holt, who has been detained for two years awaiting trial on a weapons charge. The United States has been critical of his prosecution. [https://www.sltrib.com/news/2018/04/04/us-senator-visits-venezuela-amid-talks-over-jailed-utah-man-josh-holt/ (''The Salt Lake Tribune'')]
*[[Ukraine]] and [[Turkey]] sign an agreement improving aviation co-operation. [https://aa.com.tr/en/turkey/turkish-ukrainian-aviation-authorities-ink-deal/1108306 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[China]] threatens tariffs of 25% on the import of 106 U.S. products, including [[soybean]]s and [[Boeing|Boeing aircraft]] in reaction to a previous U.S. threat of tariffs worth up to $50 billion. [http://www.dw.com/en/china-matches-uss-50-billion-tariff-threat/a-43245748 (Deutsche Welle)]
*At a summit in [[Baku]], [[India]] and [[Azerbaijan]] discuss cooperation in areas including counterterrorism, agriculture, infrastuctural development, [[women's rights]], and trade. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/india-azerbaijan-agree-for-global-action-on-terrorism201804042126070001/ (ANI)]
*The [[European Commission]] reveals it has received notice from [[France]] that the nation intends to extend passport checks, normally not carried out at [[Schengen Area]] borders, for six months beyond the present April 30 expiry date. [https://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/France-Extends-Migrant-Border-Checks-Over-Terrorism-Threat-20180404-0021.html (telesur)]

;Law and crime
*Police arrest five suspects over a firebombing of a bus in [[Limpopo]], [[South Africa]], that killed six people. [http://ewn.co.za/2018/04/04/5-arrested-for-limpopo-petrol-bomb-attack (Eyewitness News)]
*[[LGBTQ rights in the United States]]
**Voters in [[Anchorage, Alaska]], [[United States]], reject a proposed amendment to the city charter which would have restricted public restroom use to the gender appearing on the user's birth certificate. [https://www.out.com/news-opinion/2018/4/04/anchorage-alaska-voters-defeat-anti-trans-bathroom-bill (''Out'')] [https://www.adn.com/alaska-news/2018/04/03/anchorage-voters-lean-toward-rejecting-proposition-1-regulating-restroom-and-locker-room-use/ (''Anchorage Daily News'')]
*[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
**[[Jeremy Corbyn]], leader of the opposition [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]], calls for an investigation into comments by [[Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs|UK Foreign Secretary]] [[Boris Johnson]]. Johnson is facing criticisms he overstated the strength of evidence against [[Russia]], an accusation he calls "lamentable" and accuses Corbyn of sympathizing with Russia. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/apr/04/skripal-poisoning-deleted-foreign-office-tweet-leads-to-awkward-questions (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-43639801 (BBC)]
**The [[Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons]] rejects a Russian request for a joint investigation. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-43639801 (BBC)]
*[[Facebook and Cambridge Analytica data breach]]
**[[Facebook]] increases its estimate of the number of affected users to 87 million. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-43649018 (BBC)]
*The Conseil National des Barreaux, which represents [[France|French]] lawyers, calls for nationwide action to protest proposed legal reforms by Justice Minister [[Nicole Belloubet]]. [https://www.lawgazette.co.uk/news/dead-justice-french-lawyers-plan-national-action/5065508.article (''The Law Gazette'')]
*[[Metropolitan Police|Police]] arrest a 78-year-old man in [[London]] on suspicion of murder after he allegedly killed a burglar during a fight in his home. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/04/04/suspected-burglar-dies-tussle-pensioner-78/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/blogs-the-papers-43649456 (BBC)]
*Pascal Blasio makes an initial court appearance charged with causing an explosion likely to endanger life in connection to a 2017 blast that injured 31 in [[New Ferry]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-43645466 (BBC)]
*[[Search and rescue]] operations continue for three children missing after an SUV crashed off a cliff and into the sea in [[California]], killing five. The [[Mendocino County]] Sheriff says the crash was deliberate and a crime. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/04/us/hart-family-search/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
**At a meeting of the [[OPCW]], 17 of the 41 countries abstain from a vote on not allowing [[Russia]] to participate in the inquiry. 15 countries vote in favour and six against. Three countries were not present at the meeting. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-russia-chemicalweapons/russian-bid-for-joint-inquiry-into-england-spy-poisoning-fails-idUSKCN1HB12I (Reuters)]
*[[Christian extremist terrorism in the United States]]
**Lawyers representing two of the three defendants in a [[Kansas]] case alleging a [[Christian extremist terrorism|Christian extremist]] plot to bomb a mosque tell jurors the [[FBI]] manipulated and encouraged the actions of the accused. [http://kcur.org/post/defense-fbi-informant-pushed-men-stay-involved-bomb-plot (KCUR)]
*Former [[President of Bolivia]], [[Gonzalo Sánchez de Lozada]], is found responsible of the death of 60 demonstrators during protests in [[Bolivian gas conflict|October 2003]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-43642157 (BBC)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Botswana]]
**[[Slumber Tsogwane]] is endorsed and elected the 9th [[Vice President of Botswana]] by [[Parliament of Botswana|Parliament]] in a 35–1 vote. [http://www.mmegi.bw/index.php?aid=75111&dir=2018/april/05 (''Mmegi'')] [https://www.herald.co.zw/botswana-parly-endorses-new-vp/ (''The Herald'')]
*[[2018 Italian general election]]
**Ahead of formal talks on the formation of a [[coalition government]], [[Five Star Movement]] leader [[Luigi Di Maio]] states he is willing to enter government with the [[Democratic Party (Italy)|Democratic Party]] and [[League (Italy)|League]] but not with former [[President of Italy|President]] [[Silvio Berlusconi]]'s [[Forza Italia (2013)|Forza Italia]] party. [https://www.politico.eu/article/italy-luigi-di-maio-rules-out-coalition-with-silvio-berlusconi-5star-movement-forza-italia/ (''Politico'')]
*[[2018 Egyptian presidential election]], [[Censorship in Egypt]]
**[[Egypt]]ian news site ''Masr al-Arabia'' says its offices were raided and a journalist arrested in response to the republication of an article by ''[[The New York Times]]'' alleging irregularities in the nation's recent presidential election. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/04/egyptian-website-editor-arrested-for-republishing-article-on-election (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 Sierra Leonean general election]]
**[[Julius Maada Bio]] is sworn in as [[President of Sierra Leone]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-43653098 (BBC News)]

;Science and technology
*A study published to the journal ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]'' finds dozens of potential stellar mass [[black hole]]s in the [[Galactic Center]], suggesting there may be as many as 20,000 orbiting the [[supermassive black hole]] [[Sagittarius A*]]. [https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2018/04/black-hole-stellar-binary-stars-milky-way-galaxy/ (''National Geographic'')]
